checks: extra byte refused before worker allocation
one worker slot held through blocked delivery
obsolete result acknowledged without copying into the new stage
output copied while executor charge is live; only metadata survives ACK
stage swapped once after three successful tile receipts
previous complete atlas readable while a new frame is visible
later tile rejection removes its complete staging attempt and preserves the prior frame
adoption: Keep a bounded tile job and a private frame staging buffer. Perform tile handoff under the existing executor charge, and publish only once at complete current-frame ACK. Keep the previously published atlas available during assembly and on failure.
scope: Offscreen desktop JVM S2 with rectangle proxies and actual serial worker. Pulse is a test-driver dispatch budget, not actual device vsync. The declared peak covers the one selected prefix cache, two output atlases and one tile output/work reservation. Canonical inputs, spatial data, test oracle, JVM object overhead and physical heap are outside the figure. No platform no-op frame, actual GUI, physical latency or production integration claims.
